content.heading: Requirements that touch reality
content.body: Point an idea at a file. Stand in the file and see related ideas.

slides.notes: Requirements earn their keep when they touch reality.

content.heading: File references
content.body: Paths live in brackets like any other link.

slides.notes: Ctrl/Cmd-click the file reference to land in source.

content.heading: From the implementation side
content.body: Context scope works on any workspace file — not only .rq sources.

slides.notes: Related requirements should still surface from code focus.

content.heading: Loop complete
content.body: Name → link → neighbourhood → small AI slice → stitch to code.

slides.notes: When you are ready to grow past one file, advanced starts with imports.
